island.title: Moon Shoals
island.rule: Moon pools flip the island between silver illusions and black obsidian truth, shadows cast northwest betray every lie, and Hollow Wick steals your moves.
island.feel: Haunting lunar theatre where suspicion turns into optical cleverness, mirror smuggling, and unmasking your own double.
island.arc: Learn the shadow lie law from a mimic chest, flip moon pools across the shoals, clear the Inverted Palace and Doppel Theatre in either order, unmask Hollow Wick at the Masquerade, climb the Mirror Spire, and defeat him.
moments: Opening a silver chest whose shadow points the wrong way wakes a mimic, teaching the shadow law without a word.
Stepping into a moon pool sweeps a silver ripple across the shore, turning alabaster marble into black obsidian reefs.
Walking in silver while your reflection walks in black across glass, swapping worlds so both beams meet on one lock.
Losing both bolt and beam on stage, then spinning a turntable to catch Hollow Wick's own stolen beams with mirrors.
Stepping through a spire arch into a mirror-flipped fake Bell Isle where touching the false Great Lamp shatters the sky.

palace.promise: A two-world hall where moon pools swap silver illusions for black truth and your living reflection acts across looking glass.
palace.power: Moon-Glass Pocket carries orbs across world flips and pulses opposite switches.
palace.arc: Teaches two-world flips and mirror reflections, grants orb smuggling past the mimic mini-boss, chains cross-world lanterns and scales, and climaxes in a dual-world ballroom and false throne.
palace.boss: The Queen in the Glass reflects direct bolts, testing blue mirrors, reflection hits, world flips, and true shadows.

theatre.promise: A velvet playhouse in five acts where Hollow Wick steals your moves one by one until you break each stage mask to win them back.
theatre.power: Cue-Mirror lets shots pierce velvet curtains from spotlights and doubles echoes.
theatre.arc: Removes Throw in Act One and Dash with Wings in Act Two for the Cue-Mirror, branches into blind Act Three and gunless Act Four, and builds to a late-smiling vanity mirror before Curtain Call.
theatre.boss: The Understudy snatches Throw, Dash, and Bolt into orbiting spotlight masks, testing fast mask shatters mid-duel.

masquerade.promise: A gilded ballroom where every guest wears your cloak and lantern, leaving only shadows and floor reflections to betray the lies.
masquerade.arc: Starts with twin waltzing ovals of true and lying shadows, adds upside-down floor reflections, spins eight Wicks on rotating rings, and ends in a shattering chase through the spire rose window.

mirror_spire.promise: A tall prism spire uniting silver and black world flips, mirror twins, stolen moves, and counterfeit memories on the climb to Hollow Wick.
mirror_spire.arc: Deepens prism banks and lens crossings with black-world branches, adds a move-theft vault and prism duchess, peaks in a twin-world chord and fake Bell Isle, and gives a parry room before the summit.
mirror_spire.boss: Hollow Wick Unmasked tests your full kit, a center moon pool to shatter his clone, and parrying his dark lantern.
